$description: Type roles for Vintage, the Triple Feature identity. Families are self-hosted and listed in meta.json; sizes and spacing come from the shared Tailwind scale.

family.$description: All body copy, film titles in captions, metadata and inputs
Headlines, section titles, buttons, rank numbers and stamps

weight.$description: A CSS font-weight for display text. `inherit` keeps the surrounding text's (Anton has one weight)

letter-spacing.$description: A CSS letter-spacing for display text. `inherit` keeps the surrounding text's, so a parent's tracking class still reaches it

case.$description: text-transform for headlines and buttons (`case-display`). Film titles keep their own case

family.$description: Typewriter labels: 'Feature Nº 1', reasons, the footer. Sentence case, never long text
